Summoner

"Summoners like me get a bit of a cold shoulder at this school.{w}Just look at that -- the Magic Research Wing."{w}{p}"Kathleen, the vice principal... being so keen on teaching is fine and all, but...{w}I just wish the other departments got a little more attention too."{w}{p}"Hey, you lot, want me to tell you something interesting about Summoners?"{w}
Hear them out?

"Good, good. Sure thing."{w}{p}"See, summoned monsters, when you combine them with items, can be put to work in a couple of unexpected ways."{w}{p}"The first is merging with an item.{w}For example, the Cloak of Corruption and a Succubus."{w}{p}"If you've got both, try unleashing the Cloak of Corruption's hidden power while you've got a Succubus summoned."{w}{p}"Something wonderful's bound to happen!"{w}{p}"The second is boosting an item's effect."{w}{p}"For example, if you have a Unicorn Horn equipped while you've got a Unicorn summoned, it gets even more powerful."{w}{p}"And it's not just the examples I gave here -- there seem to be all sorts, so if you've got a Summoner, go looking!"{w}{p}"..........{w}Maaan, it's been ages since I got to talk about this stuff.{w}Summoning really is the best!!"{w}
note: Item names Cloak of Corruption (dataku no manto) and Unicorn Horn are provisional (not in glossary).

en: "Ugh...{w}F-fine, then...{w}So I get the cold shoulder here too..."{w}
There is a bulletin board for the Magic Research Wing.{w}

"'Miracles that borrow the power of the gods? Upset the gods and it's all over, isn't it?' -- that's what Kathleen said!"{w}

"Uh, uh, um, you two...{w}Maybe you shouldn't badmouth a teacher so much...{w}*fluster, fluster*..."{w}

"Over there, though, there's the Archbishop, y'know..."{w}
"Oh, right."{w}
"I'd love to knock Kathleen down a peg.{w}Isn't there some way..."{w}
"*fluster, fluster*... *fluster, fluster*..."{w}

"If we just handed over some sweets, Harmoni would jump at it, right?{w}Going, 'Yaaay, it's a Mont Blaaanc~~~!' and all!"{w}

Use Prof. Harmoni's grenade?

en: After making sure no one was around, you set Professor Harmoni's grenade on the door!{w}
"This is the Magic Research Wing!{w}The castle of the Mages, led by our very own Vice Principal Kathleen!"{w}
Witch
"Have you met Professor Nambino, up in the northwest?{w}If you haven't yet, go on over!!"{w}
Vice Principal Kathleen
note: Glossary name box, 23 chars (over ~16); kept, needs width check.

en: "Hello there.{w}I don't recognize your faces -- are you new students?{w}Do apply yourselves, won't you."{w}

"So it seems some youngster blew up the entrance to the Magic Research Wing..."{w}{p}"If they had to, I'd at least have liked them to blow it up with {11:0001:0015}, not a grenade."{w}{p}"...I hold every scrap of information in this school in my grasp without ever leaving my seat.{w}Every room except that person's."{w}{p}"Who is doing what, and where -- I see it all, you know...?{w}Well, I understand how you feel. It does look like favoritism, doesn't it."{w}{p}"Enlarging the Magic Research Wing and putting effort into the Mage classes doesn't mean we're neglecting the other disciplines."{w}{p}"Mage spells alone can grow in power without limit, on nothing more than the caster's state of mind.{w}Unless you understand them properly and learn them right, they're dangerous."{w}{p}"The more power someone holds, the hardest thing of all is restraining themselves.{w}That is why we nurture sound theory and a sound heart."{w}{p}"And as I gathered all sorts of materials for that purpose, the building ended up this big."{w}{p}"Yes, I suppose it's about time I gave you some instruction as well."{w}{p}"...I'll teach you that there are things you ought to learn before you go playing with grenades."{w}{p}"Rejoice. You get to take a special class from Kathleen, no less."{w}
note: ano kata ('that person', honorific) left unnamed - presumably the Board Chair. 'from Kathleen, no less' renders kono Kyasuriin kara (self-reference by name), kept gender-neutral; note Kamikaze calls Kathleen onago (woman) in slice 055 (3369) while the glossary says unknown.

en: Take the special class?

"Lecture One.{w}The role of the spirits, and the truth about {11:0001:0015}."{w}{p}"{11:0001:0015} -- renowned as the strongest attack spell of us Mages.{w}The common understanding of this spell is that it's a nuclear-blast spell."{w}{p}"But in truth, this spell is not an explosion.{w}What this spell really is, in other words..."{w}{p}"{11:0001:0015} in the narrow sense is a space-control spell: 'a spell that prepares an environment in which a High Mana Source can be created.'"{w}{p}"There is a flow of magic power surrounding our land.{w}It is fluid, like air pressure and the flow of the wind, and the Elementals and Fairies manage it."{w}{p}"From here on, I'll call the Elementals and Fairies 'spirits' for short."{w}{p}"They keep things in balance, so that magic power doesn't pool up in one spot and no place ends up with extremely thin magic power."{w}{p}"That's why, when we cast a spell, we can always expect the same effect, without feeling any difference."{w}{p}"Why do the spirits do this?{w}Apparently even they don't entirely know themselves..."{w}{p}"The current prevailing theory is that the gods instructed the spirits to even out magic power and cap it, so the land won't break in some accident... or so it's said."{w}{p}"But every so often, through some fluke, released magic power exceeds the land's limit.{w}That is a High Mana Source."{w}{p}"Making a High Mana Source is simple. You just set off several attack spells at once, in one spot."{w}{p}"Do that, and the released magic powers interfere with each other, and in no time an explosion beyond the limit breaks out.{w}But in reality, even if you try it, it fizzles."{w}{p}"Why is that?{w}It's because the spirits disperse the magic power so it won't exceed the limit."{w}{p}"Slipping past the spirits' watch to create a space where you can fire off as many spells as you like -- that is the truth about {11:0001:0015}."{w}{p}"So in theory, even an intermediate Mage could bring the land to ruin, if the spirits weren't keeping watch."{w}
note: koumagen = 'High Mana Source', kakugeki = 'nuclear-blast' (new terms). {11:0001:0015} is the top nuclear spell insert.

en: "Well, are you keeping up?{w}Shall I explain it once more?"{w}
Hear the explanation again?
"Then, shall we continue?"{w}

"Lecture Two.{w}The casting procedure for {11:0001:0015}."{w}{p}"{11:0001:0015} in the broad sense, broken down, consists of five spells."{w}{p}"First, {11:0001:0015} in the narrow sense.{w}The high-tier fire spell, {11:0001:000F};{w}the high-tier ice spell, {11:0001:0012};"{w}{p}"the high-tier lightning spell, {11:0001:0013};{w}and the teleportation spell, {11:0001:0016}."{w}{p}"Into the place made with {11:0001:0015}, you fire the three attack spells at the same time.{w}The more simultaneous they are, the greater the power."{w}{p}"However, {11:0001:0015} has one problem.{w}You can't pin down where it takes effect."{w}{p}"Because it secures a place for the High Mana Source by slipping past the spirits' watch, you can't conveniently set it up wherever you please."{w}{p}"Back when magical research hadn't yet advanced, even that was a threat."{w}{p}"So long as precision wasn't required, as in wars between nations, it was practical enough.{w}A nuisance of a grand technique that hit friend and foe alike, though."{w}{p}"So, as further research, combining it with {11:0001:0016} was proposed."{w}{p}"The method: wherever the High Mana Source forms, you swap the space with {11:0001:0016} and set it off wherever you like."{w}{p}"At first, it was a theory people laughed at, because it used too much magic power."{w}{p}"But once it became known that it was no armchair theory -- that it could be done in practice and made to occur wherever you liked -- everyone researched ways to optimize it."{w}{p}"The result is the practical {11:0001:0015} we use today."{w}{p}"Frankly, the spirits hate it quite a lot."{w}{p}"But by making mastery of {11:0001:0016} a requirement, we got them to turn a blind eye."{w}{p}"And so, as for the order in which Mage spells should be mastered..."{w}{p}"leaving {11:0001:0016} until after {11:0001:0015} is absolutely not recommended."{w}{p}"I mean, not being able to properly control where you send the explosion once it goes off -- that's far too scary, isn't it?"{w}{p}"This whole process -- lifting the limit on magic power and drawing out a nuclear blast -- would never be permitted if it had to go through the gods."{w}{p}"It's a spell only we Mages can cast, since we call on the power of the higher world directly, without going through the gods."{w}
note: kokuninshite kureru you ni natta: spirits are the subject ('came to tolerate it'); rendered 'we got them to turn a blind eye' - same meaning, perspective shift; revert to 'they came to tacitly allow it' if preferred.

en: "Lecture Three.{w}A greater power: the Ultimate Mana Source."{w}{p}"You understand how a High Mana Source works, yes?{w}Well, if you were to set off three {11:0001:0015} at the same time, that is..."{w}{p}"a thing called an Ultimate Mana Source is theorized.{w}It is regarded as a forbidden sorcerous experiment that no one in this land has ever yet attempted."{w}{p}"You set the points where three {11:0001:0015} appear to the same coordinates, all at once."{w}{p}"Imagine the three attack spells of {11:0001:0015} all becoming {11:0001:0015}, and you'll get an idea of its power, won't you?"{w}{p}"...Though I myself can't quite grasp how terrifying that power is.{w}It's simply too huge a thing."{w}{p}"Several predictions have been made about what happens once an Ultimate Mana Source forms.{w}Let me introduce them one at a time."{w}{p}"The Waltames Conjecture.{w}When an Ultimate Mana Source forms, a colossal explosion engulfs the entire land, and everything is reduced to ash."{w}{p}"...A prediction unpopular with researchers, being far too simple.{w}It would be sad if that were the answer to a mystery of so many years, wouldn't it?"{w}{p}"The minutes of the Fourth Magic Summit.{w}The Ultimate Mana Source cannot sustain itself, and through rapid contraction vanishes along with the surrounding magic power."{w}{p}"This theory leaves one point unresolved: can contracted, high-density magic power really vanish without a price?{w}Turn that around, though, and if that point can be cleared, the theory is complete."{w}{p}"The Carnier Conjecture.{w}The gods erase the land 'the moment anyone tries to create' an Ultimate Mana Source."{w}{p}"Carnier was a theologian, so the idea is that if you go past the limits the gods have set, the gods will naturally get angry."{w}{p}"The Mittneil Hypothesis.{w}The spatial destruction of the Ultimate Mana Source wipes out the spirits' control over magic power, and the land becomes one where any spell can be cast endlessly."{w}{p}"With the example of {11:0001:0017} in front of us, it's an easy one for us to accept.{w}It's the most widely supported prediction right now."{w}{p}"I suppose that's about it?{w}Now, which theory do you believe?{w}Or will you put forward a new one of your own?"{w}{p}"So, to go back to where we started....{w}As you can see, magical research lives side by side with danger."{w}{p}"If a mistake only got yourself killed, that would be fine. What's frightening is that it could even bring the whole land to collapse..."{w}{p}"That's why, even if everyone hates it, I gather every kind of information and material -- I want the students to know. That's how I see it."{w}
note: New names: Ultimate Mana Source (gokumagen), Waltames, Carnier, Mittneil, Fourth Magic Summit. 'three {0015}' kept bare: the insert is a spell name, so no plural s.

en: "And that's the end of the lecture.{w}Well? Want to hear it once more?"{w}
"Phew..."{w}{p}"......"{w}{p}"Hee hee, I'm sorry.{w}I talked far too much in one go.{w}And I have a lecture coming up, too. What am I going to do?"{w}
Kathleen poured water from a pitcher into a cup and took a breather.{w}
"Well, that's about the gist of it.{w}Study hard, won't you.{w}If you don't understand, I'll teach you again."{w}
"Oh, is that so.{w}I look forward to seeing how far you get on your own."{w}{p}"But life isn't long enough to rediscover everything from zero, you know?"{w}

"Oh my, you there.
What's with that rather jolly getup?"{w}{p}"Goodness, it's cursed, isn't it?{w}That equipment is... from Caron's shop?{w}Hmm, so in other words... you've come to challenge us."{w}{p}"Very well.{w}If you can defeat us, we will stock the Caron brand at the school store."{w}
note: gokigen na kakkou: the party is wearing Caron's cursed prototype gear (slice 030).

en: Kathleen held up a crystal and called together the staff, from the vice principal on down!{w}Before long, the faculty came gathering.{w}
"What is it, Vice Principal?{w}And just when I was in the middle of a fun, fun remedial lesson, too."{w}
Special Advisor Kamikaze

"Do you remember Caron, who came by the other day?"{w}

"As I recall, the one who wanted to sell goods through our school store, or some such..."{w}
"Don't remember!{w}I never carry memories past sundown!!"{w}

"Sounds interesting.{w}Let's put this Caron brand to the test and see what it's really worth."{w}
